name: Sanitary Napkin Scheme
benefit: Sanitary napkins are distributed to adolescent girls/women at ₹ 6/-.
eligibility_rules: Beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. Beneficiary should be a girl/woman.
documents_required: No documents are required. Note: Beneficiaries can directly approach their nearest Anganwadi Centre and buy sanitary
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline Step-1: Concerned girls/women should visit their nearest Anganwadi Centre. Step-2: They can buy sanitary napkins from there at a minimum cost of ₹ 6/-.
